hypothesis: Four independent output-channel gate/up branches may expose better internal tiling/scheduling for the dominant FFN without requantization, splitting the down reduction, or adding program evaluations.
supported_shapes: Only H=3840,I=15360, logical [1,C,1,1], physical width32, one external input and one external output. Four 3840-row gate/up chunks, concat intermediate in original row order, one full down conv.
fallback: No selection changes production defaults. Unsupported Metal/resource shapes use original kernels; ANE graph APIs reject before private calls and require explicit baseline re-selection; unsupported valid CPU layouts use old reusable packer.
additional_strata: AC, low-power-on, other pmset modes and Fair must be new independent pins/experiments; no conversion or pooling.
baseline: static-int8-ffn-cached with identical INT8 values/scales and retained baseline graph. Do not compare solely to the existing stacked candidate: this is a different graph arrangement.

bounded_schedule.kind: manual A-before / B / A-after, separate owners/processes; not scheduled by these files
bounded_schedule.drift_action: reject this block and retain every receipt; no rescaling

qualification_before_timing: No driver call in this job. After explicit local resumption and compilation, qualify ONE candidate graph first; do not provision/evaluate all48 before one-graph approval.

First one-graph component smoke: finite bit-identical FP16 outputs versus the unchanged INT8 baseline for each pinned activation, before any full-model timing. The independent CPU FFN tolerance remains max abs < 0.002. A failing exact layout check is rejection, not permission to widen tolerance.

Then all 48 layer-input fixtures across nine real autoregressive steps (432 vectors) compared to the same-rounded baseline; final token path must match pinned HF/baseline. No forced-reference-token substitution.
Generated descriptors/payload bytes, one-I/O signature and all ten FP16 GELU ops are checked on host. Those checks do not prove private-compiler acceptance.

accept_reject.scope: advance to another independently pinned confirmation, never auto-promote production
accept: Power/thermal labels remain exactly the pinned stratum and baseline bracket drift is <=5%.
Candidate target-stage median is at least5% lower than BOTH baseline-arm medians.
End-to-end request median is no more than2% above the worse baseline-arm median.
Report raw samples and uncertainty; require a second independent passing block before proposing admission.
reject: Any oracle mismatch, nonfinite valid-data output, cache miss, driver/compiler error, unexpected dispatch fallback, OOB/canary fault, changed work count, stratum transition, or drift>5%.
A speed-only win that fails quality is rejected.
An inconclusive/noisy or <5% target-stage result is not an accepted optimization.

measurement_target: ANE FFN per-step intervals, nine-step decode wall interval, and end-to-end request wall
risks: Core ML concat semantics do not establish private ANE compiler acceptance on macOS15.6.
Compiler may serialize branches, increase live intermediates, dequantize constants, or choose another reduction order.
One-graph source remains about169MiB; no additional throughput is inferred from compressed source.
Cache provisioning/load and measured evaluation are separate; any miss at inference is a stop, not a compile/retry.
invocation_limits: This array is documentation, not a runnable trial or accepted queue manifest.

Repeat --hf-reference with explicitly pinned inputs to form each bounded warmup/measured arm. Reference files carry their own token/output budget; --max-new-tokens is not relied on for reference mode.
No attempt ledger, STOP marker, process allowlist or queue entry is supplied or modified.
Initialization/compilation is excluded from steady-state timing and reported separately. No auto-download or compile-on-miss.
Use the same retained-Metal policy in all arms; the supplied historical baseline is not a substitute for these controls.

separate_future_cache_provisioning.daemon_cache_or_residency_assumption: none; inspect with existing cache mechanism only after explicit resumption
separate_future_cache_provisioning.do_not_use_all_int8_alias_for_candidate: all-int8 remains the existing baseline batch and intentionally does not select this candidate
